**This boss battle was recorded while within editor, this is not a packaged build in clarity or quality**

Devlog #001 More will follow when there is something worth showing.
In this devlog, I’m re-staging the first mini-boss fight in Grim Pulse - The First Blood; and honestly?
I still can’t get past Phase 2.

During Quest Two, Aelthar tears open the Blood Realm; a space bound between mind, blood, and will, where he has total control.  He drags the Covenless vampire Isaac into this realm, not just to fight him… but to extract information about the city Aelthar has awakened into, and the powers now ruling it.

This fight is long, brutal, and tactical; closer to playing chess under pressure than a standard action encounter.

Combat Design Breakdown

Dodge/Chase-focused, high-lethality combat

If Aelthar takes 4+ consecutive hits... it's game over, he's lost the battle of the minds in this realm.

Survival requires actively draining Isaac’s blood to heal.

No passive regen. No mercy.

Every mistake compounds.

I attempted to record this fight 30+ times, but Phase 2 consistently shuts me down; which honestly tells me the fight is doing exactly what it’s meant to do.

What’s New in This Devlog

Cinematic opening sequence

WIP voice-over dialogue (staging pass)

Full lip-sync animation on Aelthar

Major combat tuning & pacing updates

Blood Realm visual and tonal pass

Everything here is still in active development(specifically looking at the SFX layers), but this video captures the intent of Grim Pulse’s combat and narrative philosophy:
Information has a cost, and survival is earned.

If you’re into LoS1/2, DMC, GOW, and Souls-like combat, vampire lore, indie devlogs, or watching a developer get absolutely humbled by their own boss fight - you’re in the right place.

🩸 Feedback is welcome; especially on combat pacing and difficulty curves.
🩸 More Devlogs coming as the Blood Realm evolves.
